_readme: S403 SkyYarrow, 2026-10-17. The registry files Pasadena City College's catalog as PDFs by section. The college pass now reads a whole-catalog PDF (#2190); this read lists the catalog page's PDF links (shown, not followed) so a session can tell whether one file holds the 2026-2027 catalog or which section files hold its programs. One load, no model call.

questions.catalog_pdfs: Every PDF the catalog page links: its words and address, and which is the 2026-2027 catalog or its program sections.
